title: Morley Minto Reforms 1909
definition: The Indian Councils Act of 1909, popularly known as the Morley-Minto Reforms, was a legislative measure that introduced the principle of communal representation and expanded the size and functions of legislative councils in British India.
importanceInUpsc: It marks the institutionalization of the 'Divide and Rule' policy, a recurring theme in Modern Indian History, and serves as a precursor to the constitutional evolution leading to the 1919 and 1935 Acts.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Morley Minto Reforms 1909.
